summary.text: Laura Faver Dias, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 62nd House District since January 2023, according to the General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Her General Assembly biography lists her as a former social studies teacher and a small business owner.
It says she holds a B.S. from Indiana University and an M.A. from Wayne State University, is a former Grayslake village trustee, and lives in Grayslake with her husband and two children.
